Broken Circle.name: Broken Circle
Broken Circle.summary:
Broken Circle is an unreleased RPG. The game, which story was based on Nordic mythology, had a troubled development: publishers weren’t interested because it was too risky to cover the release costs for an unknown title that needed a big and expensive 256mbits cartridge.

By the time that the programmers managed to shrink Broken Circle to 64mbits, the console was at the end of its life and the only publisher interested in the game was not officially authorized by Nintendo.

X-Men 2 - La Vengeance de Wolverine.name: X2: Wolverine's Revenge
X-Men 2 - La Vengeance de Wolverine.summary: The Game Boy Advance version of X2: Wolverine’s Revenge is a separate handheld adaptation rather than a direct version of the console and PC game. It uses side-scrolling action gameplay instead of the third-person structure of the main versions, while retaining Wolverine’s claws, healing ability, and stealth-based sections. It also differs in story, locations, and boss encounters, with some characters and areas not shared with the console versions.
